Our Story

Databunker started with a simple realization: companies shouldn't need a six-figure budget and a six-month timeline to get compliant. We built a secure PII vault that encrypts and tokenizes sensitive data, giving teams a fast path to SOC 2 and GDPR compliance.

As we worked with customers, we saw that data protection was only one piece of the puzzle. Companies also needed cloud security scanning, data subject rights automation, and audit-ready reporting. So we expanded â adding Databunker Radar for multi-cloud compliance scanning across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and Databunker DPO Portal for automated privacy operations.

Today, Databunker is a complete compliance platform covering SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001, HIPAA, DPDP, and more â with automated scanning, audit-ready reporting, and secure data protection in one place.

Our model is built around growing with our customers. We offer usage-based pricing per record and request, making it easy to start at an early stage and scale as your business grows. No lock-in, no surprise invoices â just the compliance tools you need, when you need them.
